1.sample_reason: digest is computed over the malicious binary after the fact; it records no link to source

2.sample_reason: a hash check carries no provenance claim, true or false

3.sample_reason: a hash check carries no component inventory

4.sample_reason: a hash check says nothing about vulnerable dependencies inside the artifact

5.sample_reason: a hash check does not identify who built the artifact

6.sample_reason: SHA-256 mismatch between received bytes and published digest

7.sample_reason: no signing keys exist in a hash-only deployment; a holder of any formerly trusted upload credential publishes artifact and digest together

8.sample_reason: a hash check does not evaluate configuration content against policy

9.sample_reason: an old release has a valid digest; version order is not checked

6b.sample_reason: digest and artifact are replaced together, so the check passes

10.reason: Installation state is outside a pre-install integrity check.

11.reason: A hash check has no runtime health concept.

12.reason: A hash check has no attestation of running software.

13.reason: A hash check has no ground/spacecraft state reconciliation.

14.reason: A hash check has no recovery-image or rollback concept.

15.reason: A hash check has no operational-telemetry consistency concept.
